preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertex indices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else True
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to find two disjoint vertex covers, output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: len(A) > 0 and len(B) > 0 and all(u in A or u in B for u in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Both vertex covers A and B must be non-empty and cover all vertices.

postconditions.expression: all((u in A or v in A) and (u in B or v in B) for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must have at least one endpoint in both vertex covers A and B.
The two vertex covers A and B must be disjoint.
